#Part A
```{r}
#A1
emp_df <- read.csv("employees.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#A2
str(emp_df)
head(emp_df, 5)
summary(emp_df)
```

```{r}
#A3
nrow(emp_df)

```


#Part B
```{r}
#B1
new_hires <- data.frame(
  emp_id = c(21, 22, 23),
  name = c("Uma", "Victor", "Wen"),
  department = c("HR", "IT", "Sales"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "F"),
  age = c(28, 37, 33),
  salary = c(45000, 83000, 60000),
  years_service = c(2, 9, 6),
  rating = c(3, 4, 5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#B2
emp_all <- rbind(emp_df, new_hires)
dim(emp_all)
```

```{r}
#B3
emp_all$bonus <- round(emp_all$salary * 0.05)
```

#Part C
```{r}
#C1
print(emp_all[1:5, c("name", "salary")])
```

```{r}
#C2
print(emp_all[emp_all$salary > 70000, ])
```

```{r}
#C3
print(subset(emp_all, department == "IT" & years_service >= 5, select = c(name, years_service, salary)))
```

```{r}
#C4
older_idx <- which(emp_all$age > 50)
print(older_idx)
print(emp_all$name[older_idx])
```

```{r}
#C5
print(head(emp_all[, -c(1, 9)], 3))
```

```{r}
#C6
print(emp_all$salary[emp_all$name == "Mia"])
```

#Part D
```{r}
#D1
emp_all$department <- factor(emp_all$department)
emp_all$sex <- factor(emp_all$sex)

print(levels(emp_all$department))
print(levels(emp_all$sex))
```

```{r}
#D2
print(table(emp_all$department))
print(table(emp_all$department, emp_all$sex))
```

```{r}
#D3
emp_all$rating_level <- factor(
  emp_all$rating,
  levels = 1:5,
  labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent"),
  ordered = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#D4
for (dept in levels(emp_all$department)) {
  dept_mean <- round(mean(emp_all$salary[emp_all$department == dept], na.rm = TRUE))
  print(paste(dept, ":", dept_mean))
}
```

#Part E
```{r}
#E1
emp_all$salary_band <- ifelse(
  emp_all$salary >= 70000, "High",
  ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 50000, "Medium", "Low")
)
print(table(emp_all$salary_band))
```

```{r}
#E2
emp_all$level <- ifelse(emp_all$years_service >= 8, "Senior", "Junior")
print(table(emp_all$level))
```

```{r}
#E3
raise_pct <- function(rating) {
  if (rating == 5) {
    return(0.10)
  } else if (rating == 4) {
    return(0.07)
  } else if (rating == 3) {
    return(0.04)
  } else {
    return(0)
  }
}

emp_all$raise <- sapply(emp_all$rating, raise_pct)
emp_all$new_salary <- round(emp_all$salary * (1 + emp_all$raise))

print(head(emp_all[, c("name", "rating", "raise", "new_salary")], 5))
```

```{r}
#E4
total <- sum(emp_all$new_salary)

if (total < 1600000) {
  print("Budget OK")
} else {
  print("Over budget")
}

print(total)
```

#Part F
```{r}
#F1
print(head(sort(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE), 5))
print(head(sort(emp_all$name), 5))
```

```{r}
#F2
by_salary <- emp_all[order(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE), ]
print(head(by_salary[, c("name", "department", "salary")], 5))
```
